name: Access Path Predictor
definition: A knowledge-based algorithm aware of data-related logic (structure) but limited rendering logic. It assumes the most common access pattern is the frequent appearance of the same predecessor-current-successor pattern.
summary: The Access Path Predictor is a knowledge-based out-of-core algorithm that predicts and pre-caches octree nodes by learning local access traffic, unlike the Ray Driven Predictor which assumes spatial continuity.
